content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(CDR-003 Container Capability Read With Block Device Access) OR BIOC(CDR-003 Host Filesystem Access Via Proc1 Root From Container) OR BIOC(CDR-003 nsenter Into PID1 Mount Namespace Container Escape) OR BIOC(CDR-003 Anomalous Namespace Switch From Container Process) OR BIOC(CDR-003 Host Passwd Read From Container Via Namespace Escape) OR BIOC(CDR-003 Host Cron Persistence Written From Escaped Container)
